title: Reuters Q3 revenue up 12% boosted by generative AI licensing
summary:
X author: @pressgazette

Reuters reported a 12% year-on-year increase in Q3 revenue to $232m, with generative AI licensing driving a 56% rise in news division transaction revenue to $44m. This reflects growing publisher compensation through AI content licensing deals.

Linked sources:
- https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/companies-markets/thomson-reuters-posts-higher-q3-revenue-lifts-2026-forecast

title: Cloudflare adds Personal Assistants traffic category with per-agent controls; Descope launches Envoy for Personal Agent Protocol
summary:
X author: @Zunbeamzero

Cloudflare shipped a new traffic category for Personal Assistants with per-agent Allow/Block options. Descope launched Envoy supporting Meta/Sierra's draft Personal Agent Protocol for scoped agent identities and permissions, with GoFundMe and GoodRx as partners.

Linked sources:
- https://www.cloudflare.com/

title: Anthropic signs first paid licensing deal with Associated Press
summary:
X author: @bayaiuai

Anthropic signed its first paid publisher licensing deal with the Associated Press for live attributed election data in Claude, ending its holdout on paid deals after publishers blocked its crawlers.

Linked sources:
- https://www.adweek.com/

title: Google analysis shows AI Mode queries run 3x longer but not visible in Ads search terms reports
summary:
X author: @sengineland

Search Engine Land reported on a new analysis of 400+ Google Ads accounts showing that Google’s claim of AI Mode queries running 3x longer is not reflected in search terms reports, with three possible explanations identified.

Linked sources:
- https://searchengineland.com/ai-search-activity-invisible-google-ads-search-terms-reports-study-500872

title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT with Business Agents
summary:
X author: @OpenAI

OpenAI shipped Business Hub in beta, allowing eligible U.S. ecommerce and service businesses to claim profiles, publish labeled Business Agents that answer customer questions using provided data, and view aggregated insights on mentions, clicks, and topics without sharing conversations.

Linked sources:
- https://openai.com/index/introducing-businesses-chatgpt/

title: Major retailers and banks blocking or gating third-party AI agents
summary:
X author: @jonattias

Amazon, Charles Schwab, JPMorgan Chase, Delta, and others are blocking unnamed third-party AI agents (including Meta's Muse) via robots.txt or terms, or requiring signed profiles and spending limits, while building their own; Walmart launched an Agent Gateway for authenticated agents.

Linked sources:
- None supplied

title: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI agent then launched its own
summary:
X author: @AIPulseNewsX

Amazon blocked Meta's Muse shopping agent within 12 days citing unauthorized access and terms violations (while its robots.txt blocks several AI user-agents), then launched its own "Buy for Me" agent that identifies itself and allows brand opt-outs.

Linked sources:
- None supplied

title: United Airlines blocks unauthorized AI agents from booking flights
summary:
X author: @verge

United Airlines announced it will block personal AI agents from booking flights on its app and through travel agencies, citing concerns over probabilistic behavior in unpredictable environments.

Linked sources:
- https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1031623/united-unauthorized-ai-agents

title: ScrapeBench benchmark released for evaluating AI agents' legal compliance with robots.txt and terms of service
summary:
X author: @ktwu01

Researchers released ScrapeBench, a benchmark testing AI agents' compliance with robots.txt and website terms of service prohibitions on scraping across 1,626 sites.

Linked sources:
- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2411.XXXXX.pdf

title: Yahoo becomes first licensee of Internet Licensing Collective for AI content
summary:
X author: @Digiday

Digiday reports that Yahoo is the first licensee of the Internet Licensing Collective, a Spotify-like model offering publishers a new way to get paid for content used in AI search.

Linked sources:
- https://digiday.com/media/yahoo-becomes-first-licensee-of-spotify-like-collective-ai-content-licensing-model/

title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic hit with lawsuit seeking halt to frontier AI development
summary:
X author: @Reuters

Reuters reports that OpenAI, Google and Anthropic have been hit with a lawsuit seeking to halt frontier AI development over serious risks. Public Citizen and other advocacy groups filed the action.

Linked sources:
- https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-google-anthropic-hit-with-lawsuit-seeking-halt-frontier-ai-development-2026-11-12/
